shots.name: 01-overview
shots.caption: GridGuide 1.1.0: the integrated Overview, Prepare & alerts and Grid insights journey. Independently authored fiction; no live utility connection.

shots.name: 02-scenario
shots.caption: Select an approved fictional scenario and prepared milestone. Timing is a conditional Python-owned schedule, not a measured restoration outcome or confidence interval.

shots.name: 03-completed
shots.caption: Completed means declared dependency repairs are complete at this fictional milestone. The schematic has no geographic coordinates and is not utility-confirmed connectivity.

shots.name: 04-blocked
shots.caption: Blocked clearance remains unknown. Full completion is unresolved; GridGuide never converts unknown completion into a finite utility ETR.

shots.name: 05-unresolved
shots.caption: Missing evidence stays unresolved. Approved fictional definitions support this educational path, not real locations, household predictions or inferred facility attachments.

shots.name: 06-explanation
shots.caption: Ask GridGuide renders a deterministic explanation bound to this selected milestone. No external AI or browser calculation is required.

shots.name: 07-risk
shots.caption: Household predictive risk is unavailable. G4 remains an evidence-bounded No-Go. Live maps, custom crew edits, alerts and G5 interval visualization are not implemented publicly.

shots.name: 08-handoff
shots.caption: Prepare now preserves the exact approved scenario and milestone. Prepare & alerts provides generic safety guidance and snapshots; tailored communications require authorized challenge-local inputs.

shots.name: 09-offline
shots.caption: The actual service is stopped and browser networking is disabled. Only cached preparedness and the explicitly saved historical snapshot remain. Storage can be evicted; this is not live outage awareness.

shots.name: 10-policies
shots.caption: Four baselines compare identical inputs in a separate fictional operator case. Completed and restricted-horizon customer-hours differ in meaning; unresolved and censored outcomes remain visible.

shots.name: 11-tradeoff
shots.caption: Critical-first improves one critical-service latency while worsening customer-hours. Fairness tradeoffs remain visible. The strongest fixed baseline stays default; optional CP-SAT remains experimental after its failed promotion target.

shots.name: 12-reviewed
shots.caption: Explicit acknowledgements mark this fictional comparison reviewed. Changing settings or a constraint must invalidate this review; no dispatch or utility approval occurs.

shots.name: 13-override
shots.caption: A supported precedence override is recomputed and independently validated in Python. The previous review disappeared; fresh acknowledgements are required. A constraint can worsen modeled outcomes.

shots.name: 14-export
shots.caption: The actual downloaded JSON contains this reviewed fictional case. Checksums establish internal consistency, not authenticated reviewer identity or tamper-proof audit history.

shots.name: 15-replay
shots.caption: Actual Python CLI output from replaying the downloaded JSON. Replay recomputes and validates the record; it does not train a model or rerun CP-SAT.

shots.name: 16-closing
shots.caption: A reproducible fictional portfolio, not operational utility software. Start with docs/REPRODUCING_V1_1.md and run the inspected package via python deploy/serve.py. Hosting needs separate security review and authorization.
